name: Create empty environment and install independent algorithms
description: Confirms no algorithms exist initially and multiple algorithmic patterns can be installed in a single bounded environment.
steps: Open the Node Editor and verify No algorithms exist yet
Click Add first empty sandbox
In Primary algorithm choose Diffusion
In Inside an environment, select Oscillator as Install algorithm and click Add algorithm
Press Step +1
expected: Environment 1 reports 2 / 4 algorithms and shows separate Diffusion and Oscillator pattern means; both change through simulation steps.

name: Internal pattern relation changes only receiving algorithm
description: A field produced by one internal algorithm must modify a second algorithm without replacing it.
steps: Click Load example
In Inside an environment verify Env 2 has two algorithms and an internal link A1 → A2
Press Step +1 and inspect impact for A2
Uncheck Active for the internal A1 → A2 relationship, then click Step +1
expected: A2 shows nonzero input influence with its link enabled and zero local influence only when no other incoming active connection exists; the existing algorithms remain present.

name: Select exported pattern and target another specific algorithm
description: Internal algorithms remain independent while the selected output drives an explicitly selected external destination algorithm.
steps: Click Load example
In Env 2 internal workbench, choose A1 Oscillator as Expose pattern output
In Connections choose the destination algorithm for the inter-environment edge
Press Step +1
Inspect the live pattern fields and per-algorithm influence values
expected: The exposed pattern selection changes while the other algorithm remains present; the external connection targets a specifically selected existing algorithm.

name: Delete internal algorithm and retain remaining system
description: Deleting one algorithm removes its links but preserves the remaining algorithms and environment.
steps: Click Load example
In Inside an environment click Remove for A1
Inspect Environment 2 internal list and external connections
Remove the remaining A2 algorithm
expected: After first deletion Environment 2 retains A2 with no invalid links; after deleting both it becomes an empty environment without a pattern.

name: Export v3 inner and outer network, then import
description: Saves and restores the independent algorithm states and relationships in a reproducible JSON record.
steps: Click Load example and Step +1
Click Export JSON and save atunbi-g5-network.json
Click Clear workspace and confirm
Click Import JSON and select the exported file
Inspect the restored algorithm lists and edge settings
expected: The network restores two environments, four independently stored algorithm states, two inner relationships, one external relationship and the saved tick.
